title: Camp Prospect Analysis for Parents
summary: This report analyzes Camp Prospect based on information available on their website. It focuses on program quality and accessibility, highlighting key strengths for prospective parents.

sections.title: Key Strengths and Highlights of Camp Prospect
sections.content:
* **Play-based learning:** Camp Prospect offers a unique multi-age, play-based environment with activities in music, STEM, outdoor play, and more [1].
* **Themed sessions:** Each session (Building & Construction, Red White & Blue/Rainbows, Water All Around!) offers varied activities, projects and special guests [1].
* **Low student-to-counselor ratio:** With a 5:1 ratio, campers receive personalized attention throughout each session [1].
* **Community focus:** Campers participate in service projects fostering community and compassion, such as supporting local organizations [1].
* **Positive parent testimonials:** Parents praise the warm, caring staff and engaging activities, with many noting their children's eagerness to return [1].
